title: Sister Rosetta Tharpe's electric gospel guitar
summary: Sister Rosetta Tharpe mixed spiritual lyrics with electric guitar and influenced early rock-and-roll musicians including Little Richard, Chuck Berry, Johnny Cash and Elvis Presley.
why: A root of rock and roll.

unsung.contribution: Pioneered electric-guitar gospel that influenced the first generation of rock and roll.
unsung.recognition: Called the Godmother of Rock and Roll, she was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame only posthumously, in 2018.
